joinpoint: Trend Analysis by Joinpoint Regression

Source: R/joinpoint-package.R
joinpoint-package.Rd

Joinpoint regression for trend analysis of rates, proportions, counts and other series (Kim et al. 2000). The main entry point is joinpoint(); results are summarized with apc(), aapc(), model_selection() and plotted with autoplot.joinpoint().
